description: Barcode scanning system: install html5-qrcode, create barcode service layer (scanner + generator), BarcodeScanner component, and integrate into product pages
steps: Create src/services/barcode/types.ts with BarcodeFormat, ScanResult, BarcodeConfig types
Create src/services/barcode/scanner.ts with startScanner(elementId, onResult), stopScanner() functions. Support Code128, Code39, EAN13, EAN8, UPC, QR Code. Return scanned value + format type
Create src/services/barcode/generator.ts with generateBarcode(value, format) returning SVG string, and generateQRCode(data) for product QR codes containing SKU/name/price/warehouse location

Create src/components/shared/BarcodeScanner.tsx - modal/sheet component with camera feed viewfinder, emerald scanning line animation on dark overlay, beep sound on scan, close on scan or manual dismiss, shows scanned product info card after successful scan. Use Sheet from ui/ with glass styling
Add 'Scan Barcode' button on Products page (src/pages/inventory/Products.tsx) that opens BarcodeScanner, on scan navigates to product detail by looking up barcode
Enhance src/pages/inventory/ProductDetail.tsx (if exists) or create product detail section showing barcode/QR code image and 'Print Barcode Label' button that opens print-friendly view
Add barcode scanning integration to stock movements, sales orders, and receiving pages as a quick-add button that opens scanner and adds scanned product
Update src/types/database.ts Product interface to include barcode_format field if not present
acceptance_criteria: BarcodeScanner component renders a sheet/modal with camera viewfinder area and scanning animation
Products page has a 'Scan Barcode' button in its header area
Product detail shows barcode display section
pnpm build passes with zero TypeScript errors
findings: Build passes cleanly. html5-qrcode adds ~342KB chunk (gzipped ~102KB) as expected for a camera-based scanning library. BarcodeScanner component uses Sheet from bottom side for mobile-friendly UX. All integration points (Products, StockMovements, SalesOrders, Receiving) have scan buttons. ProductDetail shows barcode/QR with print support. barcode_format added to Product type in database.ts.
